newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nuclear watchdog chief to meet head of Japan's PNC.
newsitem.headline: Nuclear watchdog chief to meet head of Japan's PNC.

text.p: Hans Blix, director-general of the world's top atomic watchdog agency, will meet on Wednesday with the president of Japan's troubled state-run nuclear energy firm, government officials said.

Blix, who is on a regular visit to Tokyo, heads the Vienna-based International Atomic Energy Agency, which was set up 40 years ago under the auspices of the United Nations to monitor global nuclear energy issues.
Japan's Power Reactor and Nuclear Fuel Development Corp (PNC) is headed by Toshiyuki Kondo.
The two are scheduled to hold a brief discussion, according to the IAEA, but the exact topic and the timing of the meeting were not disclosed.
A growing list of nuclear-related accidents and cover-ups has placed the PNC under intense public scrutiny in recent months.
